description: This file defines the GenericProvider class which extends AbstractProvider, representing a generic OAuth 2.0 service provider, using Bearer token authentication. It provides configuration, URL management, response validation, and resource owner creation functionalities for OAuth 2.0 interactions.

classes.name: GenericProvider
classes.description: A generic OAuth 2.0 service provider implementation supporting dynamic URL, scope, and method configurations, including response validation and resource owner creation functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes provider options, asserting required options and configuring optional settings.

methods.name: getConfigurableOptions
methods.description: Returns a list of options that can be configured for the provider.

methods.name: getRequiredOptions
methods.description: Returns a list of options that are necessary for the provider to function.

methods.name: assertRequiredOptions
methods.description: Checks whether all required options are provided; throws an exception if any are missing.

methods.name: getBaseAuthorizationUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL used for authorization requests.

methods.name: getBaseAccessTokenUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL used to obtain access tokens.

methods.name: getResourceOwnerDetailsUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL to fetch resource owner details.

methods.name: getAccessTokenMethod
methods.description: Provides the HTTP method used for token requests, defaulting to parent implementation if not set.

methods.name: getAccessTokenResourceOwnerId
methods.description: Provides the resource owner ID key, defaulting to parent implementation if not set.

methods.name: getPkceMethod
methods.description: Returns the PKCE method to use, defaulting to parent implementation if not set.

methods.name: checkResponse
methods.description: Analyzes the response data for errors, throwing an exception if an error is present.

methods.name: createResourceOwner
methods.description: Creates a resource owner object from the response data.
